rules.seedRule: seed = 30000 + round*1000 + stage*20 + caseIndex; round7 main37000..37009, first overtime37020..37024
rules.qualification: Current survival plan, complete ordered development8 and validation20 episodes, all passed with identical source hashes. Byte-identical nine-module candidates may reference the same reports; provenance is recorded.
rules.winner: Highest paired-fixture win fraction, draws are not wins; tied leaders play five fresh paired fixtures. Structurally identical tied leaders cannot be separated and leave the round incomplete.
rules.limitations: Partial local judge. Recorded-set survival and tournament results are not an official universal guarantee.
